mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 6 months, as measured by the series value at t-2mo relative to t-6mo, indicates strengthening manufacturing activity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of rising INDPRO are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 5.5% (as of t-1mo), it signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE falls below 5.5% within the last 3 months, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) above their 6-month averages signals robust economic expansion and strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails when either GDPC1 or HOUST is below threshold but returns are positive, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 2.0% triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced liquidity and higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.0% during a monetary tightening cycle, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) over the past 6 months, as indicated by the series value at t-2mo relative to t-6mo, signals strong economic activity and rising corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in periods of rising CPIAUCSL are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceed 137,000 thousand (as of t-1mo), it indicates robust labor market conditions that fuel consumer spending and equity returns, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 137000 within the last 3 months, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 375,000 million and employment (PAYEMS) above 137,000 thousand signals strong consumer demand and labor market health, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails when RSAFS and PAYEMS are both above threshold but returns are negative, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a high industrial production level (INDPRO) above 115 (as of t-2mo) indicates overcapacity and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO > 115 during a late-cycle expansion, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
